title: Design: Turn-on window asks which customers are your own company
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have an organization where Internal Work Orders has never been turned on.
  • Start on Settings > Work Orders.
  • Open the attached pictures iwo-flow0-02-01b-turn-on-pick-your-internal-customers.png, iwo-happy-02-02-pick-your-internal-customers.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps: 1. Switch on the Internal Work Orders toggle.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • A window opens over the page with the title "Which customers are your own company?" and an X at its top right.
  • Its body reads "Work orders for these customers are internal: no prices and no invoice; parts cost posts to the expense account of their category when you use QuickBooks or AccountingHub. Nothing is picked for you: your location is not always a customer, and the names can differ. Pick one or more, or do it later from the customer page."
  • Below it is one customer search field with nothing picked, the hint "Pick up to 50 customers here. Flag more from Edit Customer." and the line "You can change this any time: Customers > Edit Customer > Internal customer."
  • Two buttons sit at the bottom right in this order: "Do this later" (white) then "Save" (blue), and Save is greyed out (disabled) because no customer is picked.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11758 (Story 1, Turn on Internal Work Orders, flag internal customers, manage categories)

  • S1-R2: “Switching the toggle from off to on for the first time in the organization opens the modal "Which customers are your own company?" with the body "Work orders for these customers are internal: no prices and no invoice; parts cost posts to the expense account of their category when you use QuickBooks or AccountingHub. Nothing is picked for you: your location is not always a customer, and the names can differ. Pick one or more, or do it later from the customer page.", a customer picker (the standard customer Select with search, several customers can be picked, each shown as a chip with a remove control; up to 50, with the hint "Pick up to 50 customers here. Flag more from Edit Customer."), the line "You can change this any time: Customers > Edit Customer > Internal customer." and the buttons "Do this later" and "Save". No customer is preselected. Save is disabled until at least one customer is picked. Save saves the toggle (on) and flags the picked customers in one step (only this toggle and the flags; other unsaved changes on the tab wait for Save settings; to back out, the user switches the toggle off and saves settings), closes the modal and then shows the dialog of S1-R11 for each picked customer with open billable work orders, one after another; the page shows the toggle on and the hint lines of S1-R3 with nothing left to save for this setting. Closing the modal with X acts as "Do this later" (S1-R5); Esc and a click outside do nothing, as in every dialog of the app. The modal is shown once per organization: switching the toggle on again later opens nothing (S1-R10). Switching it off opens nothing. The modal never lists who is flagged, and Settings > Work Orders never lists customers.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Toggle switched on for the first time | "Which customers are your own company? Work orders for these customers are internal: no prices and no invoice; parts cost posts to the expense account of their category when you use QuickBooks or AccountingHub. Nothing is picked for you. Pick one or more, or do it later from the customer page." | Modal with the customer picker, Do this later / Save (Save disabled until a customer is picked); shown once”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Internal Work Orders · All flows v6" (https://claude.ai/artifact/5jHR3nLeDinzks1viREFuo), version 1794484794-2031, read and rendered 12 Nov 2026: pages "Flow 0 · Turn it on" / "Happy flow v6", boards "01b Turn on · pick your internal customers" (Flow 0 · Turn it on), "02 Pick your internal customers" (Happy flow v6).

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • iwo-flow0-02-01b-turn-on-pick-your-internal-customers.png
  • iwo-happy-02-02-pick-your-internal-customers.png

The design's own words:

  • “Which customers are your own company?”
  • “You can change this any time: Customers > Edit Customer > Internal customer.”
  • “Do this later”

Difference: the design's body names "your Internal Work Orders Expense account" and draws Save enabled with nothing picked: register IWO-D05, settled by S1-R2.
